tools_dsl.replacement: Arbor.MCP.Server.Handler + Server.DSL tool/2,3 and declaration macros
tools_dsl.prerequisites: Rewrite use/deftool/compiler-generated consumer code; recompile; verify DSL callbacks and validation.

tools_builder.replacement: Server.DSL or application-owned dynamic descriptor/dispatch maps; no replacement struct
tools_builder.prerequisites: Separate MCP descriptor data from handler functions; migrate Builder.Tool.t/0 and param/0.

tools_registry.replacement: Handler.handle_list_tools/2 and handle_call_tool/3 with owned state; Handler.tool/0
tools_registry.prerequisites: Implement/test dynamic mutation, default application, validation and list-change notification; no process-global registry replacement.

tools_results.replacement: Server.DSL.Result.text/1, error/1, structured/2, normalize_tool/2, normalize_tool_result/1 or valid raw MCP content/result maps
tools_results.prerequisites: Account for complete result vs content-list shape, structuredContent normalization and revision-valid image/resource blocks.

tools_schema.replacement: Content.SchemaPolicy.compile/1,2 and validate/2,3; literal JSON Schema; DSL schema macros
tools_schema.prerequisites: Tagged errors differ from compile-or-raise; validation does not duplicate Helpers default insertion/coercion; handle nil bypass explicitly.

http_endpoint.prerequisites: Preserve forwarded mount, parsed-body, version, OAuth and SSE/session semantics; runtime-mounted HTTP remains pending.

http_owner.replacement: 1.x application-owned SessionRegistry; v2 explicit runtime-owned stores
http_owner.prerequisites: Do not start duplicate registry; runtime/session/HTTP convergence must be implemented and qualified.

media.replacement: Application-owned media/encoding pipeline then Content.Builders.image/2,3; no image-processing drop-in
media.prerequisites: Choose application processing/decoding and test bytes; remove no-op tokens/options with agreed rejection behavior.

metadata.replacement: Explicit application metadata map update and external EXIF processing
metadata.prerequisites: Clearing :metadata is not EXIF removal; preserve supported sanitizer operations.

consent.prerequisites: Preserve historical contextual decoding and legacy resource-not-found -32002; do not emit that code for new local consent errors.

resource_code.replacement: Protocol.ErrorCodes.resource_not_found/1 with era or negotiated revision
resource_code.prerequisites: Use established peer era: legacy -32002, modern -32602; unknown revisions remain explicit errors.

url_code.prerequisites: Preserve legacy URL elicitation -32042; modern MRTR replaces retired code, rather than re-emitting it.

initialize.replacement: Server.Capabilities.build_capabilities/1,2; handler initialize result normalized by internal Protocol.Initialize.build_initialize_result/2
initialize.prerequisites: Capabilities-only and full string-keyed wrapper have different shape; assemble server fields deliberately; legacy negotiation does not discover modern MCP.
